rules.description: Person notifying must be a registered attorney on the LPA
rules.reason_if_failed: Only registered attorneys can notify OPG of the donor's death

rules.description: The donor (LPA holder) must be confirmed deceased
rules.reason_if_failed: Notification of death can only be made when the donor has passed away

rules.description: The LPA must have been registered with OPG
rules.reason_if_failed: This LPA is not registered with OPG. Only registered LPAs need to be notified of death.

rules.description: Attorney should have the original LPA document to return
rules.reason_if_failed: You should send the original LPA document. If you cannot locate it, contact OPG for guidance.

rules.description: If donor died outside UK, death certificate must be provided
rules.reason_if_failed: A death certificate is required if the donor died outside the United Kingdom

edge_cases.description: The sole attorney has also died
edge_cases.action: If you are a replacement attorney or family member, contact OPG directly. The LPA will be cancelled.
Family member or executor should contact OPG. LPA will be cancelled.

edge_cases.description: Original LPA document has been lost
edge_cases.action: Contact OPG to explain the situation. You may need to provide a certified copy or statutory declaration.

edge_cases.description: LPA was already revoked before death
edge_cases.action: No action needed. The LPA was already cancelled before the donor's death.
